name: How should a homeowner prepare before a kitchen door frame repair visit?

mainEntity.name: How should a homeowner prepare before a kitchen door frame repair visit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the contractor arrives, clear a safe pathway through the kitchen and empty any pantry shelving or back-of-door organizers hanging on the door. It is also helpful to note when the sticking or damage occurs—such as whether the issue worsens during humid summer months or after specific kitchen tasks. Point out any nearby plumbing shutoffs or previous water leaks so the carpenter can inspect for hidden moisture behind the baseboards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear items from the doorway, remove door-hanging storage racks, provide clear access to the workspace, and note any history of leaks near the frame.
